themes.title: Rootedness
themes.summary: Like a tree planted by water, a life rooted in God stays green.

themes.title: Delight
themes.summary: God's word is something to enjoy and return to day and night, not a chore.

themes.title: Wise company
themes.summary: Whose counsel we walk, stand and sit in shapes who we become.

questions.prompt: Whose "counsel" has been shaping your thoughts most this week?
What would it look like to be "planted by the rivers of water" tomorrow morning?
Name one habit that feels like chaff — something you could let the wind carry away.

themes.title: Provision
themes.summary: With the Lord as shepherd, there is nothing essential we lack.

themes.title: Rest
themes.summary: He leads us to green pastures and still waters, and restores the soul.

themes.title: Presence
themes.summary: Even in the darkest valley, we are not alone: thou art with me.

questions.prompt: Which image speaks to where you are today?
Where do you need your soul "restored" right now?
Recall one moment this week when goodness or mercy followed you.

themes.title: Refuge
themes.summary: God is a very present help when everything else is shaking.

themes.title: Stillness
themes.summary: Stop striving, and remember who God is.

themes.title: Steadiness
themes.summary: With God in the midst, the city shall not be moved.

questions.prompt: What "roaring waters" are loudest in your life right now?
When could you practice five minutes of being still today?
Write one sentence of trust to return to when things shake.

themes.title: Help
themes.summary: Our help comes from the Maker of heaven and earth.

themes.title: Watchfulness
themes.summary: The one who keeps you never slumbers or sleeps.

themes.title: Journey
themes.summary: Your going out and coming in are kept, today and always.

questions.prompt: Where do you usually look first when you need help?
What "going out" or "coming in" are you facing this week?
